Sciences Check finds Horizon Industries, Kossodo, Ouagadougou, is an assembly plant for laptops, phones and tablets, citing its own website for a daily output of 1,000 units and Haier as technical partner.

Horizon Industries, 35% state-owned through FBDES, specialises in assembling laptops, phones, tablets and appliances, and the Council of Ministers of 19 February 2025 authorised a framework agreement of up to four years for public IT purchases from it.
